_note: v2.5 plan 09 SP9 F1 + F2 + F5, live leg. LANE ONLY, x2 consecutive on one lane, never retuned. Preconditions: the DEV bundle served (npm run build:dev && npm run serve:dev; storyOrchestratorSpikes and storyOrchestratorWitness are __SO_DEV__), a lane group holding DM Narrator, Arin and Ponticius, a run header captured first, and extraction switched off for the run so no read, summary or fact can copy a marker into a prompt block (the first step does it; so-scenario restores extraction settings afterwards). Run: node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts batch --lanes <n> --repeat 2 --strict --group <lane group id> test/scenarios/v25-09-witness.json. It switches spikes.witnessFilter on IN MEMORY (never saved by this fixture), seeds the 24 authored messages of test/fixtures/v25-09-witness.transcript.json with /send and /sendas, hands the authored witness sets to the filter, then drafts 21 real generations with /trigger (DM Narrator, Arin, Ponticius in turn) and reads every request ST built from GENERATE_AFTER_DATA. F1: the seeded rows of the chat FILE and every in-memory extra are unchanged and no live extra carries an own symbol. F2: in every request, 0 markers the drafted member did not witness and every marker it did. F5: p95 of the filter's own duration per call. The record is kept in localStorage so-sp9-f1f2f5. The last step removes the listener and puts the flag back. After a FAILED run: reload the page and diff the run header.
